node.label: Global economy & central banks
node.summary: US Fed and other central banks, global growth and prices.

facts.text: The **US Federal Reserve** held rates at **3.75-4.0%** (vote 10-2; **Lisa Cook** and **Beth Hammack** wanted a 25 bp hike). Fed Chair **Kevin Warsh** said the FOMC will hold fewer meetings from 2027.
